main_measure.name: t of mean 20-bar forward excess return (vs coin mean) on active bars, non-overlapping, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or if fewer than 30 blocks

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of 20-bar excess return on forecast level (active, non-overlapping)

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, meeting neither the confirm nor the reject rule.
reading: The coin's mean 20-bar return uses every bar's in-window 20-bar forward return across all its windows (overlapping), active blocks are grid bars 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with forecast > 0 and a full 20-bar forward return, and the supporting slope is reported but not used in the decision rule.
